questions.q: Dates are more fun with friends along than with just the two of us.
I've imagined a confession or proposal down to the place and the exact words.
After a fight, I first want to sort out what actually caused it.
I like to decide where and when we're going on a date ahead of time.
When I like someone, I only talk about it with one person I trust.
What makes me fall for someone is whether I can relax around them.
I quickly notice when the person I like is even a little bit down.
I'd rather come up with surprises on the day, depending on my mood.
When I'm interested in someone, I'm the one who goes up and starts talking.
I love talking with my partner about future dreams and "what if" scenarios.
When my partner comes to me with a problem, I tend to offer solutions more than feelings.
I like to agree early on how often we'll keep in touch and on our ground rules.

INTJ.name: Owl in Love
INTJ.one: You draw a map of the future, even in love.
INTJ.desc: You're very careful before you fall for someone. But once you decide, you quietly look ahead to your future together and treasure it. You may not say much, but you always put the choice that's best for your partner first. Sometimes you make a plan before you share your feelings, which can leave your partner a little unsure of where they stand.
good: You never date just for fun
You think seriously about your future together
You can truly support your partner's dreams
You give spot-on answers when they're stuck
You keep cherishing the one you chose
care: You can take a very long time to fall for someone
You answer with what's right instead of with feelings
You tend to plan the future on your own
Leaning on others is really hard for you
Their "I just feel like it" can puzzle you
INTJ.tip: Before giving an answer, pause and say, "So that's how you felt." Reassurance reaches them before being right does.
best: INTP
You both think about love with your heads. You give direction to their free-flowing ideas, and the conversation never runs dry.
hard: ISFJ
They show love through small, everyday kindnesses. Your future-focused love may not fill the loneliness they feel right now, so you can easily miss each other.

INTP.name: Cat in Love
INTP.one: You see the person you like as the most fascinating mystery.
INTP.desc: When someone catches your interest, you want to know everything about them. You love the little discoveries in conversation and the topics only the two of you share. Until you get close, you may seem a bit aloof, but with someone you trust, you have a soft, cuddly side. Putting your feelings into words takes you a little time.
good: You give your partner freedom, never control
You're never boring to talk to
You take a real interest in what they love
You stay calm instead of getting emotional
You're surprisingly affectionate once you open up
care: You forget to text, and they wonder if you've cooled off
You overthink when asked how you feel
You sometimes miss anniversaries
Your logic can leave them deflated
You go quiet when you're lost in your own world
INTP.tip: Try saying even half of what you're thinking out loud. The "I like you" in your head won't reach them unless you put it into words.
best: INTJ
They map out where the two of you are heading, so you can let your curiosity roam freely. A pair that stays up late in deep conversation.
hard: ISFP
They want to sense feelings through mood and expressions. Your analysis and silence can easily come across as coldness.

ENTJ.name: Lion in Love
ENTJ.one: You lead your future together, straight ahead.
ENTJ.desc: When you like someone, you make the first move and make the relationship clear. You lead without hesitation, from date plans to talks about the future, and you take pride in protecting your partner. You're incredibly dependable, but you sometimes decide things at your own pace and forget to ask how your partner feels.
good: You decide fast and never leave them guessing
You're the first to protect them in tough times
You can picture your future together in detail
You truly support your partner's growth
You always follow through on promises
care: You run dates and life a little too much
You can't show weakness
Their indecision can frustrate you
Love gets pushed back when you're busy
Your advice can sound like orders
ENTJ.tip: Before deciding, ask one question: "What would you like to do?" Your lead feels even stronger when their voice is part of it.
best: ENTP
You turn their free ideas into reality. Even your arguments are fun, an exciting pair.
hard: ESFJ
You both want to run the plans for the two of you. You decide by efficiency and they decide by feelings, so you can clash over who's in charge.

ENTP.name: Fox in Love
ENTP.one: You turn love and conversation into a new game every time.
ENTP.desc: With jokes and bright ideas, you never let your partner get bored. A little playful teasing and a few surprises turn love into a fun puzzle. With someone you click with, you fall hard, but when rules and the same routine drag on, your attention may start to drift.
good: Talking with you is just plain fun
Your date ideas are new every time
You enjoy hearing how your partner thinks
You don't hold on to fights
You believe in their potential and give them a push
care: Too much playing hard to get makes them anxious
You dodge serious talks with jokes
Fixed plans and rules aren't your thing
You may win the argument but lose ground in the relationship
You can seem easily bored
ENTP.tip: Just for important talks, give the jokes a rest. When you answer seriously, people trust you more than usual.
best: ENTJ
They seriously turn your bright ideas into reality. A pair that pushes each other and grows together through friendly rivalry.
hard: ESFP
They want their feelings received straight on. Your jokes and logic can feel like dodging, and that can make them lonely.

INFJ.name: Whale in Love
INFJ.one: You gently take in the feelings beneath the words.
INFJ.desc: You notice the feelings behind someone's expressions and words faster than anyone. You're looking for someone you can connect with deep in your heart, and once you find them, you quietly care for them for a long time. Because your ideals are high, you sometimes carry hopes you can't voice and end up worn out on your own.
good: You understand their feelings without being told
You listen seriously to deep talks
You know their good points better than they do
You cherish the one you chose for a long time
When they're lost, you quietly light the way
care: You project your ideal love onto your partner
You don't say what you mean and hope they'll guess
You suddenly close off when hurt
You wear yourself out reading their feelings in advance
You struggle alone, then one day just drift away
INFJ.tip: When you catch yourself wishing they'd just know, take it as a sign to say it. Saying it lets your depth come through.
best: INFP
You both treasure the tender parts of the heart. You scoop up their feelings, and they give you honesty in return.
hard: ISTJ
They show feelings through set habits and real actions. You may feel there's too little heart-to-heart talk, and that can get lonely.

INFP.name: Hedgehog in Love
INFP.one: You gently grow tender feelings with care.
INFP.desc: You picture the person you like in your mind again and again. You're usually reserved, but when someone accepts you as you are, you pour out deep, honest love. You're good at putting your heart into words and small gifts. But you hurt easily, and a single prickly comment can stay with you for a long time.
good: You accept your partner just as they are
You give heartfelt words and letters
You find and treasure their small good points
You connect deeply with people who share your values
You truly stand by them when things are hard
care: Fear of getting hurt keeps you from getting close
The gap between ideal love and reality gets you down
You swallow what you want to say
One comment can weigh on you for a long time
Stories tend to play out in your head
INFP.tip: When you're hurt, before your spines go up, say, "That made me a little sad." Once you say it, they can really notice.
best: INFJ
They pick up even the feelings you can't put into words. A quiet, deep pair where you can open your heart safely.
hard: ISTP
They lend a hand through actions rather than talking about feelings. The love you want to confirm in words can look like coldness.

ENFJ.name: Dolphin in Love
ENFJ.one: You want to be the biggest supporter of the one you love.
ENFJ.desc: You take your partner's dreams and worries to heart as if they were your own, and you cheer them on. You keep conversations lively and you're good at putting feelings into words, so the mood between you stays bright. But you can do so much for your partner that you put your own tiredness and true feelings last.
good: You support their dreams with everything you've got
You're good at putting feelings into words
You get along with their friends and family
You quickly lift them up when they're down
You work hard to make the relationship better
care: You try too hard to change your partner
You feel let down without the reaction you hoped for
You get anxious when they don't rely on you
You're slow to notice your own exhaustion
You avoid fights and give in too much
ENFJ.tip: If there are days you cheer, make days to be cheered on too. It's okay to say, "Today, I want you to listen."
best: ENFP
You cheer on their sudden ideas and dreams with all you've got and help bring them to life. A pair full of laughter and talk of the future.
hard: ESTJ
They prefer to move things forward by rules and results rather than feelings. Your caring words can sound roundabout, so you may not mesh well.

ENFP.name: Otter in Love
ENFP.one: With every love, your world gets bigger.
ENFP.desc: When you're with someone you like, places to go and things to do keep bubbling up. Every time you discover a new side of your partner, you light up, and you show it with your whole self. Your bright belief in what the two of you could be is your charm, but your feelings swing a lot, and the same routine every day isn't your strong suit.
good: You keep finding your partner's good points
Every date turns into an adventure
You express your feelings honestly
You can share their dreams with real excitement
You bounce back fast when you're down
care: You start to waver once the early spark settles
You change plans depending on your mood
Loneliness can quickly turn into worry
You put off practical talks
With so much on your mind, your texting gets spotty
ENFP.tip: On days when the excitement quiets down, it's not the end. It's the start of something deeper. Going back to your usual spot is a fine adventure too.
best: ENFJ
They truly cheer on your dreams and ideas and give you a push. A pair whose excitement actually leads to a future.
hard: ESTP
They enjoy the thrill of the moment. The meaning and future you want to talk about can easily get brushed aside.

ISTJ.name: Beaver in Love
ISTJ.one: You build a sense of safety, one kept promise at a time.
ISTJ.desc: In love and in life, you want to move forward one sure step at a time. You may not use flashy words, but you always keep your promises and firmly support your life together. Trust you've built over time doesn't waver easily. Still, sudden changes of plan or love driven by mood can leave you confused.
good: You always keep promises and show up on time
You're never flaky
You give practical support to your life together
You stay with the one you choose for the long run
Your words and actions always match
care: Your affection can be too low-key
Sudden plan changes annoy you
Dates tend to be the same every time
You put being right first and miss feelings
You stay quiet and put up with things instead of speaking up
ISTJ.tip: Once a month, add one thing that's different from usual to your steady routine. A small change makes your days together even more fun.
best: ISTP
You both talk little and show feelings through actions. They loosen up the promises you keep with their easygoing way, and you last quietly for a long time.
hard: INFJ
They want to understand the feelings beneath the words. Your sincere actions alone may not be enough, and they may ask, "How do you really feel?"

ISFJ.name: Bear in Love
ISFJ.one: Just being near you puts people at ease.
ISFJ.desc: You're always checking whether the one you love is cold or tired. You don't do anything showy, but you quietly support them, like handing over a warm drink. You remember their tastes and habits well and you're great at making a safe place to be. But you tend to keep your own loneliness to yourself.
good: You notice their health and tiredness right away
Your quiet thoughtfulness never stops
Being with you calms the heart
You remember what they like
You get better the longer you're together
care: You can't say no to things you don't like
After giving so much, you wait for something back
Fear of change makes you stick with how things are
You adjust so much you lose yourself
You hold it in until your limit, then tears suddenly come
ISFJ.tip: When you're about to say "I'm fine," check once whether you really are. Showing weakness doesn't take anything away from your warmth.
best: ISFP
Your quiet thoughtfulness fits their calm, easygoing pace. A pair whose quiet, warm moments last a long time.
hard: INTJ
They show love through long-term plans and logic. The everyday care you value can be easy for them to overlook.

ESTJ.name: Elephant in Love
ESTJ.one: You reliably keep your days together on track.
ESTJ.desc: You like to move forward in love with clear lines. Dating, meeting up, deciding on the future: you say it clearly and follow through as promised. You're dependable, and things get done when you're around. But you can assume your way is the right way and put the plan ahead of your partner's feelings.
good: You always keep your word
Your date planning is flawless
You think realistically about your future together
You're reliable when trouble comes
You make the relationship clear
care: You can push your way of doing things
You cut off feelings talk with "So what's the point?"
You're strict about broken rules
You don't let yourself look weak
Romantic gestures make you feel awkward
ESTJ.tip: Before asking whether it's right, ask how your partner feels right now. It adds one more layer of kindness to your reliability.
best: ESTP
You bring planning and security to their energy and drive. A pair whose days move along at a good pace.
hard: ENFJ
They want to put feelings into words and share them. Your plans and logic can look like you're leaving their heart behind.

ESFJ.name: Penguin in Love
ESFJ.one: You carefully build up your days together, one by one.
ESFJ.desc: You put your partner at the center of your life and take good care of each day. You remember anniversaries, favorite foods and how they're feeling, and you act before they ask. The sense of security you give is unbeatable, but you can give so much that you put your own feelings last.
good: You never forget anniversaries or what they like
You're the first to notice when they feel unwell
You get along with their family and friends
You keep promises, so trust keeps growing
Your life together runs smoothly with you
care: You wear yourself out giving too much
Without a "thank you," you quietly get hurt
You almost end up managing their schedule too
You store up complaints and let them out all at once
You worry too much about what others think
ESFJ.tip: Before what you want to do for them, share one thing you'd like them to do for you today.
best: ESFP
You turn the fun they bring into anniversaries and traditions. A lively pair that really lasts.
hard: ENTJ
You both want to run the plans for the two of you. You decide by feelings and they decide by efficiency, so you can clash over who's in charge.

ISTP.name: Wolf in Love
ISTP.one: Few words, but you hand over trust through actions.
ISTP.desc: Saying "I like you" out loud isn't easy for you. But you fix what's broken and quietly show up when they're in trouble. Like handing over a spare key, you turn trust into something real, little by little. You value your own time too, so a clingy relationship can feel a bit cramped.
good: You're the most reliable person in a pinch
You don't try to control, so you're easy to be with
You don't say much, but you never lie
You lend a hand without fuss
Silence between you is never awkward
care: You say "I like you" so rarely that they worry
Your texts can seem curt
You get irritated when your alone time gets cut
You go quiet when feelings come up
Before you know it, they feel far away
ISTP.tip: Once a month is enough: say "thank you" and "I like you" in words. The meaning of your actions will come across many times more.
best: ISTJ
You both show feelings through actions more than words. You can rely on the promises they keep, and you last quietly for a long time.
hard: INFP
They want to share feelings slowly in words. Your "eh, it's fine" can feel like you're taking their feelings lightly.

ISFP.name: Panda in Love
ISFP.one: You paint ordinary days in gentle colors.
ISFP.desc: You're calm and go at your own pace. But you savor ordinary time with the one you love more than anyone. Instead of words, you show your feelings through the food you shared, the views you saw and the gifts you picked. You don't like conflict and tend to laugh things off even when you're upset. Then, before anyone notices, you may have already pulled away.
good: They never have to tiptoe around you
You respect your partner's pace
You pick gifts with great taste
You make ordinary days feel special
You accept your partner without judging
care: You're slow to put feelings into words
When a fight looms, you quietly slip away
Tightly fixed plans wear you out
Instead of voicing complaints, you quietly drift away
You keep putting off talks about the future
ISFP.tip: When something bothers you, say just one word while it's still small. It's a much kinder choice for both of you than pulling away in silence.
best: ISFJ
Their careful thoughtfulness gently wraps around your easygoing pace. A pair whose calm, cozy time keeps going.
hard: INTP
They like to sort out feelings through analysis and debate. Being asked for reasons when you just want to go with what you feel can wear you out.

ESTP.name: Cheetah in Love
ESTP.one: The moment you like someone, you're off and running.
ESTP.desc: When someone catches your eye, you go see them before you even think twice. Day trips and fun plans are decided on the spot, and you whisk your partner off to exciting times. You're great at keeping things fun through action, and being with you is never dull. But because you live in the moment, feelings talk and future promises tend to get pushed back.
good: Your approach is clear and easy to read
Being with you is never boring
You act fast when trouble comes
You don't dwell on little things
You take them out for new experiences
care: You close the distance too fast in the heat of the moment
You tend to find feelings talk "too heavy"
When you get bored, your replies suddenly drop off
Promises about the future are hard for you
You forget things you said on a whim
ESTP.tip: At the end of a fun date, take one minute to ask, "How was today?" Knowing their feelings too makes love go deeper.
best: ESTJ
They catch your momentum with planning and security. A pair whose energy turns straight into memories.
hard: ENFP
They want to talk about what the two of you mean and where you're going. The more you enjoy the moment, the lighter your feelings may look to them.

ESFP.name: Parakeet in Love
ESFP.one: You turn love into an everyday celebration.
ESFP.desc: Once you fall for someone, you go all in. Every time you meet, you prepare little surprises and fun plans that turn your time together into a festival. You show your feelings straight through words and actions, so your partner always feels loved. But the quiet moments after the excitement settles can be a little hard for you.
good: Just being with you is fun
You can say "I like you" straight out
You notice and praise their small changes
Every spontaneous date becomes a memory
You can make them laugh when they're down
care: When the thrill fades, you worry they've cooled off
You make promises in the moment, then struggle later
Slow replies make your loneliness explode
You tend to laugh fights away
You suddenly go quiet when the future comes up
ESFP.tip: On quieter days, treasure the feeling of "being together is calming." Quiet time is part of your memories too.
best: ESFJ
They turn your sudden ideas into anniversaries and plans that last. A pair with both fun and security.
hard: ENTP
They enjoy bringing games and debate into love. When you want feelings back, logic comes instead, and that can feel lonely.
